learning: Track series 0.10 m (53.1), 0.12 m (69.2), 0.14 m (60.3) puts the optimum near 0.12 m. Lookahead is at its 80 mm maximum. Mass is the last untested single variable on this design.
notes: Single-variable mass test (0.8 to 0.6 kg) on the iteration 3 baseline, with the controller held fixed so the score can be compared with 69.18.
rationale: Iteration 3 (80 mm row, 0.12 m track, 0.8 kg, kp 0.8, kd 0.15) is the best run at 69.18. Iterations 4 and 5 show the track optimum is near 0.12 m: 0.10 m scored 53.14 and 0.14 m scored 60.26, both with gains retuned. Max error sits at 0.060 to 0.067 m on every track while RMS stays at 0.019 to 0.033 m, so the limit is breached by bend transients. This candidate changes only mass, 0.8 to 0.6 kg, as the Builder's isolated test, and keeps the iteration 3 controller unchanged (kp 0.8, kd 0.15, ki 0, base_speed 1.5, last_direction, weights [-2,-1,0,1,2]) so the result is comparable with 69.18. The lighter robot has less yaw inertia, so kd is not retuned before the race. If the score falls or steering oscillation rises, the next step is a controller kd change, not a geometry change.
